MCPToolProvider~modelAtlas.name: model_atlas_tool_provider
MCPToolProvider~modelAtlas.description: Publishing tools handing a registered EPackage, or an object the agent assembled, to the model atlas. Optional: this provider is absent unless org.eclipse.fennec.model.atlas.mcp.tools and org.eclipse.fennec.model.atlas.publisher are deployed and at least one of ModelAtlasPublisher / ModelAtlasObjectPublisher is configured
